title: Don Hierro
description: donhierro.com zoominfo.com/c/don-hierro-sl/347708573 Don Hierro Corporation, S.A. (roots to 1969, Panama City) is a Panama-based engineering, construction and manufacturing firm specializing in hydraulic works, concrete caissons, foundations and industrial building. With ISO 9001/14001/45001 certifications and 39,000 m² of production facilities in Colón (its own concrete plants, quarries and caisson yards), it self-manufactures critical components — a rare vertical integration in Central America. Its flagship client is the Panama Canal Authority (ACP), for which it has executed compensating-platform repairs, drainage works at the Espíritu Santo and Pirro locks and coastal work for the Third Bridge consortium (~$22–28M). It also builds water-supply systems (Caños de Brea, David pipeline with EMPESA), bridges, dams, breakwaters and drip-irrigation (Netafim) agriculture projects.
